method: Full-record re-import comparison; normalized Sanskrit comparison; similarity-based critical-edition candidate discovery. No claim of full philological or translation certification.
normalization: NFC; ignore spaces, line breaks, compound hyphens, apostrophes and verse punctuation. Do not normalize letters or accents.
sourceDependence: GRETIL, Sanskrit Documents and the Sinh Sanskrit digitization share distinctive errors. They must not be counted as three independent manuscript witnesses.
